E_INTERNAL.fix: Retry with --verbose and report the issue with its requestId if it persists.

E_BAD_REQUEST.fix: Check the parameters and try again.

E_USAGE.fix: Run genpm --help to see the available options.

E_CONFIRM_REQUIRED.fix: Run in an interactive terminal, or pass {flag} to confirm.

E_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.message: The request body is too large.

E_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the spelling or search with genpm search <query>.

E_NO_MATCHING_VERSION.fix: Run genpm info {name} to see the published versions.

E_RANGE_UNSATISFIED.fix: Install a compatible version of the conflicting package first, or pin a different version.

E_ALREADY_INSTALLED.fix: Nothing to do. Use genpm list to see installed packages.

E_VERSION_EXISTS.fix: Versions are immutable: bump the version in genpm.json and create a new tag.

E_DRIFT.message: {name} has local changes in {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.
E_DRIFT.fix: Use --keep-code to keep your code, or --force to delete it anyway.

E_BUSY.message: Another GenPM process is modifying this project.
E_BUSY.fix: Wait for it to finish. If none is running, delete .genpm/.lock.

E_PLAN_STALE.message: The project changed since the plan was computed.
E_PLAN_STALE.fix: Compute the plan again (dry run) and confirm it.

E_NETWORK.fix: Check your connection, proxy or GENPM_REGISTRY, then retry.

E_UPSTREAM_GIT.fix: Check that the repository is reachable with your Git credentials, then retry.

E_RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} and retry.

E_READ_ONLY.message: The registry is in read-only mode during maintenance.
E_READ_ONLY.fix: Installing still works. Try publishing again later; status updates on genpm.net.

E_INTEGRITY.fix: Do not use this package. Report it with genpm.net/report if it persists.

E_SIGNATURE.message: The registry signature of {name} is invalid.
E_SIGNATURE.fix: Do not install it. Update GenPM (new signing keys) and report it if it persists.

E_PATH_UNSAFE.fix: Use a relative path inside the project, without .., absolute paths or reserved folders.

E_AUTORUN_FILE.fix: These files are never installed. Ask the author to remove them, or use --allow-autorun only for verified publishers.

E_SCAN_FAILED.fix: Fix the findings listed by genpm validate and publish a new version.

E_QUARANTINED.fix: Try again later or choose another package. Reviews take less than 24 business hours.

E_REF_MUTABLE.fix: Use a Git tag or a full 40-character commit SHA, never a branch.

E_TOO_LARGE.fix: Exclude files with .genpmignore, or raise the limit with --max-size if the package is legitimate.

E_MANIFEST_INVALID.fix: Fix the fields listed in the details. Run genpm validate for a full report.

E_LOCK_INVALID.fix: Restore it from Git; never edit genpm.lock by hand.

E_NAME_MISMATCH.message: The manifest name {actual} does not match {expected}.
E_NAME_MISMATCH.fix: Publish with the name declared in genpm.json.

E_REF_NOT_FOUND.fix: Create and push the tag: git tag {ref} && git push --tags.

E_REF_NOT_PUSHED.message: {ref} is not on the remote or points to another commit.
E_REF_NOT_PUSHED.fix: Push the tag with git push origin {ref}.

E_REPO_NOT_ALLOWED.message: {repo} is not owned by the scope @{scope}.
E_REPO_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Publish from a repository of the GitHub owner linked to the scope.

E_REPO_CHANGED.fix: Email hello@genpm.net with subject [SECURITY] to transfer the package.

E_CONTEXT_MISSING.message: The AI rules file {path} does not exist.
E_CONTEXT_MISSING.fix: Create {path} (genpm init generates a template) or set x in genpm.json.

E_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.message: The AI rules file {path} is larger than 16 KB.
E_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE.fix: Shorten it: keep the rules focused on purpose, map, integration, conventions and don'ts.

E_AUTH.message: You are not logged in, or your token is invalid or expired.
E_AUTH.fix: Run genpm login (or set GENPM_TOKEN in CI).

E_FORBIDDEN_SCOPE.fix: Ask an owner of @{scope} for publish rights, or use your own scope.

E_GIT_MISSING.message: Git is not installed or is older than 2.25.
E_GIT_MISSING.fix: Install Git 2.25 or later, then retry.

E_NODE_VERSION.fix: Update Node.js, or install the standalone genpm binary, which does not need it: genpm.net/docs/install

E_UPGRADE_UNSUPPORTED.message: This copy of GenPM was installed with {via}: genpm upgrade only updates the standalone binary.
E_UPGRADE_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Update it with {command}, or install the binary from genpm.net/docs/install.

E_UPGRADE_PERMISSION.fix: Run genpm upgrade as the user that owns that file, or reinstall with the script from genpm.net/docs/install.

E_UPGRADE_INTEGRITY.message: The downloaded {asset} does not match its published SHA-256 checksum.
E_UPGRADE_INTEGRITY.fix: Nothing was changed. Retry later; if it happens again, report it to hello@genpm.net with the subject [SECURITY].

E_NOT_A_PROJECT.fix: Run the command inside a project (with package.json or .git), or pass --cwd <dir>.
